continuity: Jin Taekyung is now a Level 71 Peak Master with forty-five years of internal energy and seventy unassigned stat points.
Taekyung received the Quest Find the Master Artisan, requiring him to commission a Master Artisan to forge his Ten-Thousand-Year Cold Iron into a weapon.
The Jin Family recently learned of a reclusive master artisan living nearby; Jin Wikyung will verify the information and send word.
Taekyung wants information about the Fire King and will not decide whether to learn the Flame Divine Palm until he confirms whether the Fire King is alive or dead and consults Jin Wikyung.

Jin Wikyung already knows about the Flame Divine Palm, presumably because Jin Mukyung told him; Hyuk Mujin learns that Taekyung obtained its manual after the Eight Spring Gorge battle and once offered it to him.
plot: Jin Taekyung celebrates reaching Level 71 and the Peak realm, then examines the Ten-Thousand-Year Cold Iron he obtained and receives a Quest to find a Master Artisan capable of forging it into a weapon. He hopes to make his own spear and plans to ask the Jin Family or Wolhwa for help locating the artisan.

Jin Wikyung and Hyuk Mujin arrive to celebrate Taekyung's breakthrough, producing an absurd exchange in which Mujin takes credit for standing guard and Wikyung jokingly promises him the position of Family Head. After the commotion, Taekyung asks Wikyung to investigate both the master artisan and the Fire King.

Wikyung promises to consult Taekyung before learning the Fire King's Flame Divine Palm and reveals that the Jin Family recently discovered a reclusive master artisan nearby, whose skill places him among the world's top ten. Taekyung then reminds Mujin that he once saw and refused the Flame Divine Palm martial arts manual during the Eight Spring Gorge operation.

active_continuity: The unnamed old man is a Supreme Peak master nearing one hundred years old whose old age causes increasingly long periods of unconsciousness; he delayed its effects for roughly twenty years with two jiazi of internal energy.
The old man can use Samadhi True Fire and possesses overwhelmingly potent Scorching Yang Qi, along with extraordinary physical strength.
The old man is searching for an unidentified Peak master who mainly uses a sword and palm techniques; he carries a portrait and sought information from the Northern Gaoyuan's local powers.
Black Sand attempted to manipulate the old man's senility through a plan to locate the sought-after master and obtain the old man's martial arts.
The old man killed Black Sand with a single palm after overhearing the plan; Chinggen and Temur survived.
The old man left the Northern Gaoyuan for Datong on the Shanxi–Gaoyuan border and said he would return in about a month.
Jin Taekyung is now a Level 71 Peak Master with forty-five years of internal energy and seventy unassigned stat points.
Taekyung received the Find the Master Artisan Quest to commission a Master Artisan to forge his Ten-Thousand-Year Cold Iron into a weapon.
The Jin Family recently learned of a reclusive master artisan living nearby, whose skill is said to rank among the world's top ten; Jin Wikyung will verify the information and send word.
Taekyung seeks information about the Fire King and will consult Jin Wikyung before deciding whether to learn the Flame Divine Palm.
Hyuk Mujin knows that Taekyung obtained the Flame Divine Palm martial arts manual after the Eight Spring Gorge battle and once offered it to him.
open_questions: Who is the unnamed Supreme Peak master, and what is his relationship to the Peak master he seeks?
Who is the unidentified Peak master being sought, and where is that person?
Who is the reclusive Master Artisan capable of forging Ten-Thousand-Year Cold Iron?
Is the Fire King alive or dead, and where can he be found?
